title: Not important in read-only records the correction and says why (real account, read-only)
steps: With the work account in read-only safe mode, focus an Important conversation
Open Settings › Importance & labels › Tracking and look under Corrections
expected: A toast says “Recorded for testing. Mail can't change importance while read-only.” The conversation stays where it was and nothing is written to Gmail. The correction is listed as Not important (was Important).
